main_text.p: fussis[?] celebres. Habetu erim, qui dum uos longo po,t fe r eli qu t fpacio, infamia & diri nominis me moria liberat: Romanum uidelicet pontificem, quum in patris uiscera fili gladium stringi praecipit Hec ille. Nec ita conquieuit horribilis monstri,. Papae huius, odium, quum in mortuum eius cadauer rabide saeuierit, exhumari per literas[?] iusserit[?], extra Ecclesiam proiici, a Leodio ad Spiram transRheni[?], & quinquennio carere Christiana sepultura. Sic regem honorabat, 1. Petri 2. sic Dei institutis obeduit, Rom. 13. superbissimus Antichristus. Sed attende quid interim fecerit Deus. Sanguis (teste Vrspergense[?] chronographo) ex panibus fluxit Spirae, in signum pontificiae tyrannidis. Guar-dastalli[?] anno Domini 1106. conuentum principum & episcoporum habuit, cum quibus egit de rebus fidei, ad culmen pertinentibus, utpote de homagijs, studijs, & episcoporum sacramentis, laicis prius exhibitis. Rauennatem quoq; archiepiscopum terris suis spoliauit, sibi ipsi eas adijciens. Cum ue-rò recusaret, episcopos confirmare ab Henrico quinto constitutos, ab eodem Imperatore post pe-dum oscula capitur, & in carcerem truditur: nec inde educitur, donec omnes confirmaret: inuesti-endius[?], Carolo Magno datum, diplomate resti-tuerit, atq; ipsum Imperatorem confirmaret. Dum

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the first word of the page is a fragment and is uncertain. "Habetu" and "erim" are printed as shown, with the abbreviation of enim not expanded. The reading "po,t fe r eli qu t fpacio" is damaged and uncertain. "Vrspergense" and "dastalli" are uncertain. "innefti-endius" is uncertain. The hyphen after "ue-" and "pe-" is printed. The word "prius" is printed at the line end and may be split. The page number is at the top right.
